lines.en: Bow on my back, I hug the walls.
I seek height and a firing line.
These crypt steps will do.
I walk behind the melee draugr.
My quiver's running low.
Bone on flagstone, soft steps.
I move along the colonnade.
I round a sarcophagus for an angle.
The string slackened; I tighten it.

lines.zh: 我们一前一后，配合着走
lines.en: We move in pairs, covering each other.

lines.zh: 我在找能藏住自己的暗处
lines.en: I look for dark spots to hide in.

lines.zh: 高处看得清，也难被打到
lines.en: High ground sees all and is hard to hit.
Bow raised, string taut.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁听下面的动静
lines.en: Pressed to the stone, I listen below.
This bow is ancient wood.
The arrowheads are dark.
The melee ones are ahead.

lines.zh: 我在等一个清楚的轮廓
lines.en: I wait for a clear silhouette.

lines.zh: 墓里的风是从上面下来的
lines.en: The crypt's draft comes from above.
Twelve arrows; I'm counting.

lines.zh: 火把灭了更好，我熟这里
lines.en: Dark is better; I know this place.
If someone comes, I see them first.
You're caught in my arrow lane.
I needn't come close.
Your head is in my sight.
We're bracketing you.
Your shield won't help; I aim for the legs.
Bow drawn, I wait for you to show.
Did you hear the bowstring?
You should be behind a pillar.

lines.zh: 那根柱子挡不住两支箭
lines.en: That pillar won't stop two arrows.
I've been up high the whole time.
The bow's limb cracked.
I drag my quiver back behind the pillar.
A bone got chipped.
My quiver shook hard.
This won't stop my draw.
The melee filled in.
I moved to another corner.
String's intact; I can still shoot.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，可惜没打断
lines.en: You hit me, but nothing broke.
Here's one back.
I want arrows, not bread.
Food means nothing to the dead.

lines.zh: 你举着它，只是暴露位置
lines.en: Holding that just marks your position.
Arrows are all I want.
Move it; it blocks my aim.
Trading that for your life?
I don't even eat.

lines.zh: 那点东西，引来的是近战那几个
lines.en: That would draw the melee ones.
Put it away; don't wave it.
That thing in your hand glows.
You bumped my bow.
I retreat behind a pillar.
The melee ones will answer for me.
Close quarters aren't my strength.
That shook my quiver.
Don't crowd me; I need room to draw.

lines.zh: 石板上的声音暴露了你
lines.en: Your steps on stone give you away.

lines.zh: 你撞我，只是让我记住距离
lines.en: Bumping me just tells me the range.

lines.zh: 我把弓横过来挡了一下
lines.en: I swing my bow across to block it.
You hit the bow's limb.
I'm the legion's archer.
My duty is shooting.
Not in the line.
Only archery remains in this body.
The hand on the string doesn't talk of this.
Get back to your position.
Between us there's only covering fire.
I haven't arrows to spare.
Don't pester the one holding the string.
Hold your firing lane.
Broken arrows on the ground.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看看能不能用
lines.en: I pick them up to check.
A string snapped; I replace it.
I bend slowly; plates clatter.
Arrows must be pulled from bodies.
This one's still usable.

lines.zh: 我把这支箭捋直了收好
lines.en: I straighten this arrow and stow it.
Crypto leavings get reused.
Don't take it; I need it.
Counting what's left.
You're in my lane.
The string is at full draw.
Melee presses; I cover.
I'll hit your legs; you won't walk.
I have three angles from here.
Looking up for me won't help.
The first arrow is a ranging shot.
You lingered in front of that pillar.

lines.zh: 我的箭不响，先到身上才响
lines.en: My arrow is silent until it lands.

lines.zh: 队里已经封了你的退路
lines.en: The squad has cut your retreat.
I don't need to see your face.
These bone hands are steady.
Did you hear it?
That's a string, not wind.
Lucky miss on that one.
The next won't miss.

lines.zh: 你身上的甲，缝在哪我知道
lines.en: I know where your armor seams are.

lines.zh: 我挪到另一根柱子后面
lines.en: I move behind another pillar.
You can't see me now.
I sight you from the far colonnade.
Counting arrows? Don't bother.

lines.zh: 近战把你逼向我的方向
lines.en: The melee are herding you toward me.

lines.zh: 你背对着的时候最好打
lines.en: You're easiest when your back is turned.

lines.zh: 风从上面下来，我算过了
lines.en: The draft comes from above; I've allowed for it.
You're pressed to one side of the pillar.
The other side is in my lane.
Your movement is rhythmic.
Three steps, one pause; easy to predict.
I wait for the pause.
Bones steady, string steady.
Heard the second string?
That was me adjusting.
My kin are at the corridor's end too.
All you have left is that pillar.
The pillar is shedding dust.
Every arrow lands by your feet.
Your exits narrow.
One arrow at your calf.
I shoot the hand holding your weapon.
The arrow skims past your shield.
This one sticks in the flagstone.
You back off; I reposition.
Three arrows in a row.
These bone hands draw fast.
My aim beats my strength.
Even behind the pillar you're not safe.

lines.zh: 我射你的脚，让你慢下来
lines.en: I hit your feet to slow you.
The bowstring sounds a second time.
You blocked that one.
The next comes from the flank.
The melee are closing.
This range is just right for a shot.
Falling back to my lane.
A bow is lifted from a stone shelf.
I rise on the high platform.
My quiver is still full.
The string sounds once first.
The melee are already forming up.
I take in the hall from the dark.
The torches died; perfect.
This is the best angle in the room.
Bone fingers hook the string.
No breathing, so my hands are steady.

lines.zh: 门那头的动静，我听到了
lines.en: I heard the noise at the door.

lines.zh: 你进门的第一眼该看我
lines.en: I should be the first thing you see.
I'm the third in the squad.

lines.zh: 诗意一点说，我是影子里的箭
lines.en: Poetically, I'm the arrow in the dark.
Fire caught my bowstring.
I fell from the platform.
Water seeped into my joints.
The blast collapsed the stone shelf.
So you can shoot too.
This magic spoils my aim.
No offerings; I can't draw full.
Lightning lit the whole corridor.
No platform beneath me.
